name: How do professionals dry out a bathroom after a bathtub overflow?

mainEntity.name: How do professionals dry out a bathroom after a bathtub overflow?

acceptedAnswer.text: Professionals use a systematic approach to dry out a bathroom after a bathtub overflow. First, they extract standing water using powerful pumps and wet vacuums. Next, they deploy industrial-grade air movers and dehumidifiers to circulate air and remove moisture from structural materials. Specialized moisture meters are used to detect hidden moisture in walls, floors, and ceilings. They also often use thermal imaging to identify cold spots indicative of moisture. This ensures thorough drying, preventing mold and secondary damage, and may involve strategic demolition of unsalvageable materials.
acceptedAnswer.description: Professionals extract water, then use industrial air movers, dehumidifiers, and moisture meters to thoroughly dry affected areas, including hidden spaces, to prevent mold and further damage.
